title: Contract Architecture and Upgradeability
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Contract Architecture and Upgradeability and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 18: Contract Architecture and Upgradeability; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 18 roadmap: Designing Contract Boundaries and Responsibilities; Separation of State and Behavior; Factory Contracts and Deployment Patterns; Minimal Proxy Contracts; Transparent Proxy Architecture; Universal Upgradeable Proxy Standard (UUPS); Beacon Proxy Architecture; Storage Layout Compatibility; Initializers and Upgrade-Safe Constructors; Upgrade Authorization and Governance; Timelocks and Administrative Delays; Upgrade Testing and Migration Planning; When Immutability Is Preferable to Upgradeability. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
